items.notes: Observability section landing; topic-adjacent but does not establish the indicator-versus-objective distinction.
Tail-latency chapter; release-halt policy for correctness failures is outside its stated scope.

Graph-traversal page; keyset-pagination cursor guarantees are not addressed.
